svg.title: Exocrine acinus and endocrine islet
svg.desc: Left: an exocrine acinus, a ring of acinar cells full of enzyme granules around a small lumen that drains into a duct toward the duodenum. Right: a mouse-style endocrine islet with beta cells in the core and alpha and delta cells at the rim, beside a capillary that carries hormones into the blood. First enzymes flow down the duct, then hormones leave the islet into the capillary.
